mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_documents (oss_key, title, region, doc_type, source_type, source_name, source_url, metadata_json, status, ingest_progress, retry_count, last_error_code, error_message, disabled_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ossKey}, #{title}, #{region}, #{docType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{metadataJson}, #{status}, #{ingestProgress}, #{retryCount}, #{lastErrorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{disabledAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rag_documents WHERE oss_key = #{ossKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM rag_documents WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND status = 'indexed' ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_documents SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE rag_documents SET status = #{status}, ingest_progress = #{ingestProgress}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_documents SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
